tools.android-build: locates the Android SDK's d8 and javac for i-slint-backend-android-activity's build script
tools.autocfg: probes the compiler for cfg flags
tools.bindgen: generates Rust declarations from Skia's headers; Skia's own notices are ADR-0057's (skia_notices.py)
tools.cc: drives the C compiler; the sources it compiles are the crate's own or a sources entry's
tools.flate2: unpacks skia-bindings' prebuilt Skia archive, whose notices are ADR-0057's
tools.gl_generator: generates glutin's EGL and GLX function tables into its build output, from the Khronos registry
tools.heck: case conversion in skia-bindings' build script
tools.i-slint-common: shared build-time helpers; where it is compiled in, it is a normal dependency and listed as one
tools.pkg-config: locates system libraries, which the programs link and do not contain
tools.regex: text matching in skia-bindings' build script
tools.slint-build: compiles this repository's own .slint files into Rust
tools.tar: unpacks skia-bindings' prebuilt Skia archive, whose notices are ADR-0057's
tools.vcpkg: locates libraries on Windows MSVC; nothing found on these targets
tools.walkdir: declared by jni 0.22.4, whose build script only sets cfg flags and uses it nowhere

sources.name: openssl-src
sources.read: openssl-sys's build script (vendored, under rusqlite's bundled-sqlcipher-vendored-openssl) compiles OpenSSL 3.6.3 from openssl/ into the program; OpenSSL is Apache-2.0, its text in openssl/LICENSE.txt, and it publishes no NOTICE. The crate's own LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE cover its build code, which is not compiled in.

sources.name: sqlcipher-src
sources.read: libsqlite3-sys 0.40.0's build script compiles sqlcipher/sqlcipher.c (SQLCipher 4.20.0 on SQLite 3.54.1) into the program and never LIBTOMCRYPT_SOURCES, so LICENSE-libtomcrypt (WTFPL) covers nothing shipped. The amalgamation's copyright lines are ZETETIC LLC's, whose BSD-3-Clause notice is LICENSE-sqlcipher; SQLite's part is public domain (blessing) and owes no notice. The crate's own LICENSE (MIT) covers its Rust code, which is not compiled in.
